title: Invicta Cast Iron Rectangular Dish – Red – Made in France
description:
Beautiful Invicta enameled cast iron rectangular dish, made in France, perfect for gratins, roasting, baking, or serving directly at the table. The piece features a classic red exterior with a light interior and sturdy side handles for easy handling.
Made from cast iron, it offers excellent heat retention and even cooking, ideal for both oven use and table presentation.
It measures approximately 16 x 10 x 4 cm (as marked on the base).
In good vintage condition, with signs of use such as light surface marks inside and minor wear on the edges (see photos), fully functional.
